summary: Platanus is a Latin American accelerator programme for technical founders. Its Spanish-language homepage states that selected startups receive an investment of $200,000 for 7% of the company and join a three-month programme with a community of Spanish-speaking founders, mentors from companies such as Toku and Buk, and a demo day. Portfolio pages include Fintoc and Toku. Founders apply through the site. Sector, geography beyond Latin America and a street address are not stated.

investmentEvidence.fact: Linked from the homepage as a portfolio startup (Platanus 2021 batch per the mentor note). The investment date is not stated.
Linked from the homepage as a portfolio startup. Round and date are not stated.
